Tesaṃ tumhamha-saddā' maliṅgattā...ahaṃ puriso, ahaṃ kaññā, ahaṃ napuṃsakamīti tīsu liṅgesu samānarūpaṃhoti. Rū,ṭī.p-69.] I ( usage referred to oneself). Amha(neut.) [Aka+ha. Amati pavatīti amham, asmhā. Ṇvādi,222.] Stone, piece of rock. See Asma. See Amha (kri) Atthi (2).
